title: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna
raw_excerpt: OpenAI introduced GPT-5.6 Preview, a family of models named Sol, Terra, and Luna, with Sol positioned as the flagship model. The system card describes stronger cyber and bio safety testing, new safeguards, and a limited preview before broader availability.
summary: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.6 预览版，包含 Sol、Terra、Luna 三个模型，其中 Sol 为旗舰。系统卡显示更强的网络与生物安全测试、新防护措施，目前仅限有限预览。这是 OpenAI 在模型安全与能力平衡上的重要一步。

title: Musk Says Grok 4.5 Entered Private Beta
raw_excerpt: Elon Musk said Grok 4.5 was in private beta at SpaceX and Tesla. The model is based on a 1.5T V9 foundation model with Cursor data added during supplemental training. Early evaluations were near or above Opus, with reinforcement learning still improving the model.
summary: 马斯克宣布 Grok 4.5 在 SpaceX 和特斯拉内部私测，基于 1.5T V9 基础模型并加入 Cursor 数据。早期评估接近或超越 Opus，强化学习仍在改进中。这标志着 xAI 在推理模型上的重大进展。

title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: Reaching Trillion-Parameter Performance with a 35B Agent
summary: 一篇论文提出仅用 35B 参数的智能体，通过扩展推理时计算而非参数规模，达到万亿参数模型的性能。该方法在多个基准上验证了效率，为低成本高性能 AI 提供了新路径。

title: South Korea to spend $1T on more memory chip production and humanoid robots
summary: 韩国宣布史上最大规模产业投资计划，总投资超 5760 亿美元，重点发展半导体、物理 AI 与 AI 数据中心。三星和 SK 海力士将共同投资 800 万亿韩元新建芯片工厂，并推动人形机器人产业。

title: 全球首个：隐空间世界模型，打通长时序双向物理因果链了！
raw_excerpt: 刚融了2亿美元，冲到了具身榜单第一
summary: 全球首个隐空间世界模型发布，打通长时序双向物理因果链。该模型在具身智能榜单上排名第一，刚获 2 亿美元融资。它通过隐空间建模实现更高效的物理推理，对机器人领域意义重大。

title: Google Limiting Meta's Gemini Use
raw_excerpt: Google reportedly limited Meta's access to Gemini capacity after Meta requested more compute than Google could provide. The shortfall was said to have delayed some internal Meta AI projects and pushed staff to use AI tokens more efficiently.
summary: 据报道，Google 限制了 Meta 对 Gemini 模型的计算资源访问，因 Meta 需求超出 Google 供应能力。这导致 Meta 内部 AI 项目延迟，员工需更高效使用 AI Token。凸显大模型算力分配的战略博弈。

title: Lawmakers want to ban AI companies from selling your health data
raw_excerpt: A new proposal would ban the sale of Americans' health and location information to data brokers - including information people reveal to an AI chatbot like ChatGPT or Claude. In the coming weeks, Senator Elizabeth Warren (D-MA) and Representative Mary Gay Scanlon (D-PA) are planning to debut a new version of the Health and Location Data Protection Act that's better suited to the AI era. The former version of the bill, first introduced in June 2022 , prohibited data brokers from collecting and selling health and location data. Four years later, it's expanded to ban other companies from selling such data to brokers, and to specifically cover  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 美国参议员 Warren 和众议员 Scanlon 计划推出新版《健康与位置数据保护法》，禁止 AI 公司出售用户健康与位置数据，包括 ChatGPT 等聊天机器人收集的信息。这是 AI 隐私监管的重要立法动向。

title: DiScoFormer: One transformer for density and score, across distributions
summary: Allen AI 发布 DiScoFormer，一种统一的 Transformer 架构，可同时建模密度函数和得分函数，适用于多种分布。该方法简化了生成模型的训练流程，在密度估计和采样上表现优异。

title: Open Memory Protocol – One Memory Store for Claude, ChatGPT, Curso
summary: 开源项目 Open Memory Protocol 发布，旨在为 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 等 AI 工具提供统一的内存存储。通过标准化接口，实现跨平台记忆共享，提升 AI 代理的连续性和个性化体验。

title: Accelerating Gemini Nano models on Pixel with frozen Multi-Token Prediction
raw_excerpt: Models like Gemini Nano and Gemma make it possible to have powerful large language models right in your pocket. Delivering these models on mobile was a significant challenge. Google built a new architecture that retrofits Multi-Token Prediction onto existing 'frozen' Gemini Nano v3 models to overcome the bottleneck. The new architectural components were designed to maximize efficiency gains specifically for mobile environments. This article shows how Google's research team tackled the unique, extreme constraints of edge computing.
summary: Google 研究团队提出一种新架构，在已冻结的 Gemini Nano v3 模型上附加多 Token 预测模块，显著加速移动端推理。该工作解决了边缘设备上大模型部署的瓶颈，对端侧 AI 发展有重要推动。
